J-01.name: Watch a ticker and see the live tape cockpit
J-01.notes: PROMOTED partial -> passing in iter-3. All six panels render live values on SIM-BUYER (Quote bid 122.60/ask 122.62/spread 0.02=ask-bid/last 122.62; 15 recent trades with price/size/side; 30s features incl. trade_speed 2.03/s, aggressive_buy_ratio 0.955, net_aggressive_volume 14000, buy_price_impact +0.390, sell_price_impact -0.120; tape state Buyer Control @ 0.888; 3 observations; event log) and the UI's own WebSocket opened and received 577 live frames (connStatus 'live', no page reload). The iter-2 blocker -- the colorless cockpit -- is RESOLVED: the iter-3 fix (adding ./lib to tailwind content globs) emits the 8 dynamic format.ts color classes as base utilities; the color layer now computes emerald, verified by getComputedStyle + a document.styleSheets base-selector probe (NOT by eye). Evidence: UT-J-01-J-02-cockpit-green.png, UT-J-01-idle-before-watch.png.

J-02.name: Buyer-control scenario is identified
J-02.notes: PROMOTED partial -> passing in iter-3. Data/behavior re-verified (guard intact): tape state buyer_control @ confidence 0.888 (>= 0.60 threshold); aggressive_buy_ratio 0.955 high; buy_price_impact +0.390 POSITIVE (price-impact guard NOT relaxed -- backend untouched this iteration); event log shows 'Tape state changed to buyer_control'. The iter-2 color blocker is fixed: all four color-gate elements -- (a) 'Buyer Control' headline (text-emerald-400), (b) confidence-bar fill (bg-emerald-500), (c) BUY trade-side cell, (d) positive buy_price_impact -- compute emerald (rgb(52,211,153) / bar rgb(16,185,129)), explicitly NOT slate rgb(226,232,240) (the iter-2 colorless value), measured via getComputedStyle. SELL cells and negative sell_price_impact correctly compute rose, confirming side/sign semantics render. By design the numeric confidence readout 0.888 stays neutral slate (not a defect).

The prior color blocker is RESOLVED -- the rose confidence-bar fill (bg-rose-500) and seller state color (text-rose-400) are now confirmed present as base utilities in the served bundle (iter-3 latent-class guard), so the seller bar is no longer latent-broken. Remaining work is a browser-verify pass (lean): watch SIM-SELLER, assert seller_control @ confidence >= threshold, high aggressive_sell_ratio, NEGATIVE sell_price_impact (mirror price-impact guard), the first on-screen rose render (measure via base-selector probe), and 'Tape state changed to seller_control'.

J-04.name: Bid absorption is detected (price impact, not aggression)
J-04.notes: Not built/verified yet. The amber color blocker is RESOLVED at the bundle level -- text-amber-400 / bg-amber-500 are now confirmed present as base utilities in the served stylesheet (iter-3 latent-class guard), so absorption will no longer render colorless/indistinguishable from control. This is the DEFINING price-impact case (high aggressive sell volume + no meaningful price drop => bid_absorption, NOT seller_control); the critical anti-goal makes it higher-stakes than J-03 -- likely a FULL-depth iteration. Fold in the deferred stream-status-dot consolidation here (drive the top-bar dot from snapshot.stream_status) since absorption/no-data exercises stale/closed states.

J-08.name: REST and the live UI agree (single source of truth)
J-08.notes: Stays GREEN -- re-verified in iter-3 as the required-still-passing guard proving the color-only change altered no engine value. Exact UI == REST agreement across 15 metrics vs GET /tape/SIM-BUYER/state + /features (tape_state buyer_control; confidence UI 0.888 == REST 0.8882575...; bid 122.60; ask 122.62; spread 0.02 = ask-bid; last 122.62; trade_speed 2.03; volume_speed 513.3; aggressive_buy_ratio 0.955; aggressive_sell_ratio 0.045; net_aggressive_volume 14000; buy_price_impact 0.390; sell_price_impact -0.120; average_spread 0.020; large_print_count 8). One engine value per metric, no UI-side recomputation -- a colorless number and a green number are the same number. First fully-green journey (iter-2), held green iter-3.
